summary: Iteration 22 — RETEST of iteration-21 critical bug (master ACTIVE/DISABLED Switch on a collapsed dealership group ALSO expands the group on react-native-web). FIX VERIFIED. All 6 acceptance checks PASS at 1440x900 as admin@fourbuy.co.za on /dealers. (1) PRIMARY — Tap master Switch (group-toggle-5b5cd0c6-3f06-45c4-8067-52c40f0c92bf, Ford Bryanston, 2 users) while collapsed: switch flips ACTIVE→DISABLED, header sub still reads '2 users', dealership counter goes '17 active · 3 suspended' (baseline was '17 active') confirming cascade suspension of both Johann Linsky + Zelda Visagie, AND dealer-card DOM count stays at 0 — group REMAINS COLLAPSED. (2) PRIMARY — Tap again to re-enable: DISABLED→ACTIVE, counter goes back to '19 active · 1 suspended', dealer-card count still 0. (3) SECONDARY — Tap group-toggle-open-5b5cd0c6-... (left half chevron+title): 2 dealer-cards appear (Johann Linsky, Zelda Visagie) and chevron flips to chevron-down. Cancel button closes cleanly. (5) REGRESSION — When Ford Bryanston is expanded, all per-user action testIDs are present for both users (10 total = 5×2): dealer-edit-<uid>, dealer-reset-pw-<uid>, dealer-active-toggle-<uid>, dealer-add-teammate-<uid>, remove-dealer-<uid>. (6) Collapse via left half returns dealer-card count to 0. The refactor at dealers.tsx:606-654 — making the outer container a plain <View> and wrapping ONLY the chevron+title block in a <TouchableOpacity testID='group-toggle-open-<id>'> while leaving the groupToggleWrap (Add-User icon + Switch) as a sibling <View> — is the correct and clean fix and works reliably on react-native-web. rca_of_issue: N/A — bug already fixed. Root cause was: react-native-web renders <Switch> as a plain <div role='switch'> which does NOT stopPropagation, so a click on the Switch bubbled up to the outer <TouchableOpacity onPress={toggleExpanded}>. Fix: pull the outer TouchableOpacity apart so the toggle-tap-target is ONLY the chevron+title (left half), and place the Switch + Add-User in a sibling <View> — no bubble path to a toggle handler exists anymore.
